query: 一季度的总销售额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(order_amount) AS 总销售额 FROM fact_order WHERE date_id BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20250331 LIMIT 1000

query: 平台一共有多少条订单记录？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 订单总数 FROM fact_order LIMIT 1000

query: 全部订单的销量总和是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(order_quantity) AS 总销量 FROM fact_order LIMIT 1000

query: 平均每笔订单的金额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(order_amount) AS 平均订单金额 FROM fact_order LIMIT 1000

query: 一月份有多少天下过订单？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT date_id) AS 下单天数 FROM fact_order WHERE date_id BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20250131 LIMIT 1000

query: 按大区统计销售额
gold_sql: SELECT r.region_name AS 大区, SUM(f.order_amount) AS 销售额 FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id GROUP BY r.region_name LIMIT 1000

query: 各省份的订单数量
gold_sql: SELECT r.province AS 省份, COUNT(*) AS 订单数 FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id GROUP BY r.province LIMIT 1000

query: 每个月的总销售额
gold_sql: SELECT d.month AS 月份, SUM(f.order_amount) AS 总销售额 FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id GROUP BY d.month LIMIT 1000

query: 按商品品类统计销量
gold_sql: SELECT p.category AS 品类, SUM(f.order_quantity) AS 销量 FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category LIMIT 1000

query: 各会员等级客户的消费总额
gold_sql: SELECT c.member_level AS 会员等级, SUM(f.order_amount) AS 消费总额 FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.member_level LIMIT 1000

query: 按品牌统计销售额
gold_sql: SELECT p.brand AS 品牌, SUM(f.order_amount) AS 销售额 FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.brand LIMIT 1000

query: 男女客户的订单数量对比
gold_sql: SELECT c.gender AS 性别, COUNT(*) AS 订单数 FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender LIMIT 1000

query: 每个季度的平均订单金额
gold_sql: SELECT d.quarter AS 季度, AVG(f.order_amount) AS 平均订单金额 FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id GROUP BY d.quarter LIMIT 1000

query: 销售额最高的前3个大区
gold_sql: SELECT r.region_name AS 大区, SUM(f.order_amount) AS 销售额 FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY 销售额 DESC LIMIT 3

query: 销量排名前5的商品
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name AS 商品名称, SUM(f.order_quantity) AS 销量 FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY 销量 DESC LIMIT 5

query: 消费金额最高的客户是谁？
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name AS 客户名称, SUM(f.order_amount) AS 消费总额 FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_name ORDER BY 消费总额 DESC LIMIT 1

query: 销售额最低的3个品牌
gold_sql: SELECT p.brand AS 品牌, SUM(f.order_amount) AS 销售额 FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY 销售额 ASC LIMIT 3

query: 订单数量最多的前两个月份
gold_sql: SELECT d.month AS 月份, COUNT(*) AS 订单数 FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id GROUP BY d.month ORDER BY 订单数 DESC LIMIT 2

query: 华南地区的总销售额
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(f.order_amount) AS 总销售额 FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id WHERE r.region_name = '华南' LIMIT 1000

query: 苹果品牌的销售额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(f.order_amount) AS 销售额 FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.brand = '苹果' LIMIT 1000

query: 女性客户的订单数量
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 订单数 FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.gender = '女' LIMIT 1000

query: 手机数码品类的总销量
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(f.order_quantity) AS 总销量 FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.category = '手机数码' LIMIT 1000

query: 黄金会员客户的消费总额
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(f.order_amount) AS 消费总额 FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.member_level = '黄金' LIMIT 1000

query: 上海市的订单数量
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 订单数 FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id WHERE r.province = '上海市' LIMIT 1000

query: 2月份的总销售额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(f.order_amount) AS 总销售额 FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id WHERE d.month = 2 LIMIT 1000

query: 华南地区一月份的销售额
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(f.order_amount) AS 销售额 FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id WHERE r.region_name = '华南' AND d.month = 1 LIMIT 1000

query: 黄金会员在手机数码品类的消费总额
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(f.order_amount) AS 消费总额 FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id WHERE c.member_level = '黄金' AND p.category = '手机数码' LIMIT 1000

query: 女性客户各品牌的消费金额
gold_sql: SELECT p.brand AS 品牌, SUM(f.order_amount) AS 消费金额 FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id WHERE c.gender = '女' GROUP BY p.brand LIMIT 1000

query: 一季度各大区 iPhone 15 Pro 的销量
gold_sql: SELECT r.region_name AS 大区, SUM(f.order_quantity) AS 销量 FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.product_name = 'iPhone 15 Pro' GROUP BY r.region_name LIMIT 1000

query: 白银会员平均每单消费金额
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(f.order_amount) AS 平均订单金额 FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.member_level = '白银' LIMIT 1000
